Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds in document CHEMBL4004822. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve SMILES. Filter by doc_chembl_id. Return all rows including those without SMILES. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
